primary_metric: Unweighted mean of municipality MAE within each object, then equal mean across objects
comparison_status: Previously exposed in earlier project experiments; retrospective comparison, not an independent final test
history_policy: Past dates only in training; freeze all outcome-derived features at the start of each validation/comparison window
fit_policy: Train and learn all transformations on strictly earlier dates, keep all objects of one date together
weight_policy: Equal total training weight per object; optional predeclared recency weights, never evaluation outcomes
selection_policy: All candidate settings, feature selection and ensembles are selected only on declared development windows
comparison_gate: Explicit freeze with input/code hashes and chosen configuration before opening 2023-2025 comparison
temporal_limit: Source vintage and historical publication evidence remain unverified; original strict pipeline is unchanged
text_policy: Official titles only for conservative target-blind lexical direction proxies. Unreviewed brochure-object mappings are excluded
poll_policy: Optional latest SSR/gfs.bern wave published before the prediction cutoff. Keep all objects, with exact structural fallback when no poll exists. Historical chart versions remain unverified. Polls anchor a population-proxy-weighted prediction, never the observed current result or the unweighted municipal mean
forecast_horizon: Features available before each vote (default cutoff previous calendar day); the polling extension is a near-vote specification and must not be presented as an early forecast
stopping_policy: Document each trial and next hypothesis; do not claim 4 points unless observed. Stop a search family when validation gains plateau, preserve the best honest result and the remaining data limitations
